gr00t_inference.hf_repo.text: HuggingFace dataset/model id (e.g., ``"nvidia/GR00T-N1.7-LIBERO"``). Required for ``download_checkpoint``. Read by ``download_checkpoint`` and by ``lifecycle="full"``.

gr00t_inference.hf_subfolder.text: Subfolder pattern within the HF repo (e.g., ``"libero_spatial"``). When set, only files matching ``<subfolder>/*`` are downloaded.

gr00t_inference.hf_local_dir.text: Where to download the checkpoint. Defaults to ``$STRANDS_BASE_DIR/checkpoints/<basename(hf_repo)>``. Also the host side of the ``/data/checkpoints`` bind mount, so it is confined to the base directory rather than accepted anywhere on the host.

gr00t_inference.hf_token.text: HuggingFace API token, for gated repos. Falls back to the ``HF_TOKEN`` / ``HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN`` env vars, which is the preferred way to supply it - a token passed here travels through the tool call.

gr00t_inference.lifecycle.text: Which phase ``action="lifecycle"`` runs: ``"full"`` (default - chain ``build_image`` → ``download_checkpoint`` → ``start_container`` → ``start`` and wait for the port) or ``"teardown"`` (remove the container). Ignored by every other action.

gr00t_inference.remove_volumes.text: Under ``lifecycle="teardown"``, also remove the container's docker volumes. Default ``False``, which preserves the checkpoint and HuggingFace-cache mounts; passing ``True`` discards downloaded checkpoints, so a later ``lifecycle="full"`` re-downloads.

gr00t_inference.force.text: Override the idempotence of the setup steps - rebuild the image, re-download the checkpoint, or recreate the container even when the artefact is already present. Default ``False``, which makes a re-run after a crash resume rather than repeat work.

lerobot_teleoperate.policy_path.text: Checkpoint the ``dagger`` action rolls out autonomously between human takeovers. Required for ``dagger``; ignored by every other action.

lerobot_teleoperate.dagger_input_device.text: How the operator seizes control during a ``dagger`` rollout - ``"keyboard"`` (default) or ``"pedal"``. Any other value is refused.

lerobot_teleoperate.dagger_num_episodes.text: Cap on the corrections collected in one ``dagger`` session. A positive whole number, or None for no cap.

train_policy.lora_r.text: LoRA adapter rank, read only when ``method="lora"``. A positive integer, or None to keep peft's default. It is the denominator of the ``lora_alpha / lora_r`` scaling, so anything else is refused by preflight.

train_policy.lora_alpha.text: Numerator of the LoRA ``lora_alpha / lora_r`` scaling, read only when ``method="lora"``. A positive integer, or None to keep peft's default. Zero trains an adapter whose scaling is ``0.0`` and which therefore cannot change the model, so it is refused rather than run.

train_policy.lora_target_modules.text: Comma-separated module names the LoRA adapters are attached to, read only when ``method="lora"``. Omit to keep the backend's default target set.
